# Membrane AAC plugin v0.19.4 - Table of Contents

> Membrane Multimedia Framework plugin for AAC

## Pages

- [Membrane AAC plugin](https://membrane-aac-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-aac-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.AAC.Parser](https://membrane-aac-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.AAC.Parser.md): Parser for Advanced Audio Codec.
- [Membrane.AAC.Parser.ADTS](https://membrane-aac-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.AAC.Parser.ADTS.md): Utility functions for parsing and generating ADTS encapsulation structures.
- [Membrane.AAC.Parser.AudioSpecificConfig](https://membrane-aac-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.AAC.Parser.AudioSpecificConfig.md): Utility functions for parsing and generating Audio Specific Config.
- [Membrane.AAC.Parser.Esds](https://membrane-aac-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.AAC.Parser.Esds.md): Utility functions for parsing and generating `esds` atom.

- Deprecated
  - [Membrane.AAC.Filler](https://membrane-aac-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.AAC.Filler.md): 
Element that fills gaps in AAC stream with silent frames.
